get.description: Get some basic information of the current blockchains status.

application.description: The configured name of the node, usually 'BRS'. But can be different for other chains/networks

time.description: The current time as a timestamp in seconds since block 0.

clockOffsetSeconds.description: Estimated offset of the node's local clock in seconds, from the timestamps of new blocks. Positive means ahead, negative means behind. Includes the block propagation delay, so a correct clock shows a small positive value. `null` until enough new blocks were seen.

clockDrifting.description: `true` if `clockOffsetSeconds` or `peerClockOffsetSeconds` is beyond `clockDriftWarnSeconds`. Enable time synchronization (NTP) on the host then.

clockDriftWarnSeconds.description: Threshold in seconds above which the clock counts as drifting (`node.clockDriftWarnSeconds`). 0 means the check is disabled.

peerClockOffsetSeconds.description: Median offset of the node's local clock in seconds against the clocks connected peers reported in the handshake, corrected for the round trip. Positive means ahead, negative means behind. Independent of `clockOffsetSeconds`. `null` until at least 3 peers reported a clock within the last 2 hours.

peerClockSamples.description: Number of peers with a clock sample from the last 2 hours.

averageCommitmentNQT.description: The networks average commitment per TiB expressed in Planck

numberOfBlocks.description: The number of blocks including the current non-forged block

lastBlockchainFeeder.description: The public available name of the last node that communicated with this node

lastBlockchainFeederHeight.description: The last block height this nodes got from the feeder

isScanning.description: Indicates if this node is scanning/syncing
